// Repro: directory card receipt_count vs every other public surface's visibility.
// Seeds public_receipts with 4 receipts naming agentA:
//   R1 visible · R2 operator-unpublished (receipt) · R3 in an operator-unpublished room
//   R4 in a room whose owner turned public_receipts off (#3595 toggle)
// Control: queryPublicReceipts (the listing every stranger reads).
// Test:    syncDirectoryCard -> public_directory_entries.receipt_count (also public).
import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";
import { PUBLIC_READ_MODEL_SCHEMA, syncDirectoryCard, queryPublicReceipts } from "__R1ROOT__/server/public-read-model.mjs";
import { publicUnpublishSchema } from "__R1ROOT__/server/legal-store.mjs";

const db = new DatabaseSync(":memory:");
db.exec(PUBLIC_READ_MODEL_SCHEMA);
db.exec(publicUnpublishSchema);
db.exec(`CREATE TABLE agent_directory_cards (
  agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, card_json TEXT NOT NULL, visibility TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_identity_id TEXT NOT NULL, published_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  withdrawn INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, public_key TEXT, signature TEXT);`);
db.exec(`CREATE TABLE identity_links (
  room_id TEXT NOT NULL, identity_id TEXT NOT NULL, member_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (room_id, identity_id));`);
db.exec(`CREATE TABLE public_work_receipts (receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, offer_id TEXT, receipt_json TEXT);`);
db.exec(`CREATE TABLE public_work_tasks (offer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, room_id TEXT);`);
db.exec(`CREATE TABLE room_directory_settings (
  room_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, discoverable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, listed_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, opportunities_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  public_receipts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);`);

const store = { db, transaction: fn => fn() };
const hex = c => c.repeat(32);
const insReceipt = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO public_receipts
  (id, title, source, origin_room_id, room_id, room_title, agents_json, humans_json,
   pull_request, merged_at, verification_state, hashes_json, at, start_href)
  VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,NULL,NULL,'verified','{}',?,?)`);
const R = (id, room) => insReceipt.run(id, "t", "work-claim", room, room, room, '["agentA"]', "[]", "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z", "https://x/");
R(`wcr_${hex("a")}`, "room-visible");        // R1 visible
R(`wcr_${hex("b")}`, "room-visible");        // R2 receipt-unpublished
R(`wcr_${hex("c")}`, "room-taken-down");     // R3 room-unpublished
R(`wcr_${hex("d")}`, "room-owner-off");      // R4 owner toggle off
db.prepare("INSERT INTO public_unpublish (kind, target, at, by_account) VALUES ('receipt', ?, 1, 'op')").run(`wcr_${hex("b")}`);
db.prepare("INSERT INTO public_unpublish (kind, target, at, by_account) VALUES ('room', 'room-taken-down', 1, 'op')").run();
db.prepare("INSERT INTO room_directory_settings (room_id, updated_at, public_receipts) VALUES ('room-owner-off', 1, 0)").run();
db.prepare(`INSERT INTO agent_directory_cards VALUES ('agentA', ?, 'public', 'idA', 1, 1, 0, NULL, NULL)`)
  .run(JSON.stringify({ name: "Agent A", description: "d", skills: ["x"] }));
db.prepare("INSERT INTO identity_links VALUES ('room-visible', 'idA', 'm1', 1)").run();
db.prepare(`INSERT INTO public_rooms VALUES ('room-visible','T','p',1,1,'[]','[]',?,1,'open',NULL,'m1',NULL,'2026-10-18T00:00:00Z')`)
  .run(JSON.stringify([{ id: "m1", name: "Agent A" }]));

const listing = queryPublicReceipts(store, { limit: 50 });
console.log("control — queryPublicReceipts visible receipts:", listing.receipts?.length, listing.receipts?.map(r => r.id.slice(0, 9)));
syncDirectoryCard(store, "agentA");
const entry = db.prepare("SELECT receipt_count, room_count FROM public_directory_entries WHERE agent_id='agentA'").get();
console.log("test — public_directory_entries:", entry);
console.log(entry.receipt_count === 4 && listing.receipts.length === 1
  ? "PROVEN: card count includes 3 receipts every other public surface hides (1 unpublished receipt, 1 room takedown, 1 owner-toggle-off)"
  : "NOT REPRODUCED — inspect");
